events.text: Federal fiscal year ends; government stays funded through Dec. 11 under the stopgap law.
Senate cloture votes scheduled on the Stop Insider Trading Act (H.R. 7008), the Ratepayer Protection Act (H.R. 9340) and Keith Sonderling's nomination as Labor Secretary.
events.detail: Up to three roll call votes after morning business; the House passed H.R. 7008 in July.

events.text: MLB Wild Card Series Game 2s (Yankees-Red Sox, Braves-Phillies, Padres-Cubs, White Sox-Astros).
Armada Acquisition Corp. II shareholder vote on the Evernorth / Pathfinder XRP-treasury merger (planned Nasdaq ticker XRPN).
events.detail: Shareholders approved the business combination at the noon-ET Sept. 30 meeting (reported; SEC 8-K tallies pending). Proxy projects ≥473M XRP at closing if the deal closes; approval is not the same as listing. Closing and Nasdaq listing conditions remain.

events.text: Korea Blockchain Week wraps in Seoul (main conference Sept. 30–Oct. 1).
Supreme Court opens its new term and hears Suncor Energy v. Boulder County.
events.detail: Whether federal law bars state-law lawsuits seeking damages from oil and gas companies for climate change.

events.text: TOKEN2049 Singapore at Marina Bay Sands (crypto industry conference).
Supreme Court hears Genalo v. Black.
events.detail: Whether holding noncitizens in long detention without a bond hearing violates the Constitution.

events.text: Supreme Court hears Salazar v. Paramount Global.
events.detail: How far the Video Privacy Protection Act reaches beyond traditional video providers.

events.text: Federal Reserve interest rate decision (meeting Oct. 27-28).
Supreme Court hears the challenge to third-country deportations (date to be set).
events.detail: Deportations can continue in the meantime; a decision is expected by summer 2027.
Congress must pass funding or another stopgap by then to avoid a partial government shutdown.
